All work for this dispatch is complete and green. Summary of the resolution:

## Defect and repair
The escalated clause — pullback along an **arbitrary** cellular diagonal makes every AHSS page, $E_1$ included, an associative bigraded ring — is false. The interval witness ($X=[0,1]$, six-segment cellular path, $\Delta_*[e]=2(v_0\times e)+2(e\times v_1)-(v_1\times e)-(e\times v_0)$, $a\cdot a=a$, $a\cdot z=2z$, so $2z\neq4z$ in $E_1^{1,0}$) is retained in step 7.2. The item now asserts exactly what is available:

* **(a)** the typed pairing $\mu_1^{p,q;r,s}:E_1^{p,q}\times E_1^{r,s}\to E_1^{p+r,q+s}$ with $E_1^{p,q}=h^{p+q}(X^p,X^{p-1})$, plus the relative $D$-term pairing $h^m(X,X^{p-1})\times h^n(X,X^{r-1})\to h^{m+n}(X,X^{p+r-1})$, with no associativity/commutativity/unitality claimed;
* **(b)** Leibniz rule for $d_1=jk$ and descent to $\mu_2$ on $E_2$, **proved locally**;
* **(c)** unital associative graded-commutative rings, derivations, $E_{r+1}\cong H(E_r,d_r)$ and cup-product identification **from $E_2$ on**, cited as the standard multiplicative structure of a pairing of filtering towers (Dugger §3.1/Thm 3.4; Miller L29 pp. 100–101), with $F^pF^q\subseteq F^{p+q}$ and $E_\infty\cong\operatorname{gr}_Fh^*$; the theorem now says "multiplicative from its second page on".

The misused lifting-calculus citation/dependency was deleted, [F3] and the Source notes now state each source's actual setting, the stale Ji manifest/coverage rows were corrected, and two boundary-evidence entries plus the pre-repair `risk_review` were replaced/removed. I also corrected an error I found in the old explanation of the witness ($z$ is a $d_1$-*boundary*, not a non-cycle; $d_1z=0$ since $E_1^{2,0}=0$) while leaving the arithmetic untouched.
